_comment: Weekly targets are effective sets per muscle (primary = 1.0, secondary = 0.4, openGym's own convention). Edit freely.

stimulusFactors._comment: How much a conditioning set (wall balls, sleds, metcon reps) or a cardio set (run, row, ski) counts toward the weekly targets, relative to a strength set. A first guess: tune it after a few real weeks.

runs._comment: ASSUMED. Your real runs live in Garmin/Google Calendar; edit this to match, or set to {} to ignore runs.

addOns._comment: Optional suggestions only. Never added to your routine without you saying so. Titles use Hevy names.
